title: Energy Spectra of Magnetostatic Oscillations in Ferrite Disk Resonators
abstract: Ferromagnetic resonators with short-wavelength, so-called magnetostatic (MS), oscillations can be considered in microwaves as point (with respect to the external electromagnetic fields) particles. It was shown recently [E. O. Kamenetskii, Phys. Rev. E, 63, 066612 (2001)] that MS oscillations in a small ferrite disk resonator can be characterized by a discrete spectrum of energy levels. This fact allows analyzing the MS oscillations similarly to quantum mechanical problems. In this paper we give the results of energy spectrum calculations for MS oscillations in a ferrite disk resonator.
